requirements.quote: The Device must be able to perform and sustain the Device acceptance tests.
requirements.text: The device must pass and maintain acceptance tests.

requirements.quote: The Device must power ON from the DC source (5V/2A) when connected to the power supply module even when the battery is connected to the power supply module.
requirements.text: The device must power on from a 5V/2A DC source even with the battery connected.

requirements.quote: Insert the Pi OS SD card into the Pi board and Press Button 1 (Power Button), then the Device LCD must indicate the Pi Booting stage and after show the Pi home screen.
requirements.text: The device must display booting and home screen upon powering on with the Pi OS SD card inserted.

requirements.quote: The power supply module must be able to charge the battery while powering the Device from the 5V DC source.
requirements.text: The power supply must charge the battery while powering the device.

requirements.quote: Load the Device Test application and Press Button 1 (Power Button), then on the Test application screen the battery indicator must show that it is charging by increasing the battery percentage
requirements.text: The test application must show the battery charging status.

requirements.quote: The power module circuit must be able to track the Lithium-Ion battery level and communicated this through an I2C interface.
requirements.text: The power module must monitor battery level and communicate via I2C.

requirements.quote: Load the Device Test application and Press Button 1 (Power Button), then on the Test application screen the battery indicator must show that it is charging
requirements.text: The test application must display the battery charging status.
